Whether you're decorating a study, preparing for Reformation Day, or searching for meaningful Christian home decor—this printable poster brings the 95 Theses right into your space. 4595749006.body:
Sip on faith with every brew ☕

Whether you're a reformed theologian, seminary student, or just love a little Latin with your latte—this "Always Reforming" mug is your daily reminder. The speckled ceramic feels substantial in your hands, the engraved text catches the light, and it's available in 4 beautiful color combos.

Perfect for your home office, dorm desk, or as a thoughtful gift for the theology nerd in your life. A little piece of church history you can actually use. ✨📖
4595749006.alt_text: A speckled ceramic coffee mug engraved with "Reformed and Always Reforming" in four available color options.
